description: This PHP source file defines the 'Country' controller class within the OpenCart admin module. It manages operations related to country data, such as generating country information files, listing countries across stores, retrieving country details, deleting and clearing country data files, and generating country lists for localizations. The class interacts with various models for task management, localisation, store settings, and file system operations to facilitate these functionalities.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing country data operations such as generating JSON files, listing countries, retrieving details, deleting, and clearing country-related files in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates all country data files by queuing tasks for clearing old data, listing countries, and fetching country info for each country.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates country list data for all stores and languages, queuing tasks to produce localized country data files.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed country information and queues tasks to generate localized info files for a specific country.

methods.name: countries
methods.description: Generates a JSON list of countries for a specific store and language, saving it to a designated directory.

methods.name: country
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific country, generates related localization files, and returns success or error messages.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes country JSON files for all stores and languages, and queues a task to refresh the list.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated country JSON files across stores and languages, effectively clearing localized country data files.
